premises.text: Existing safety tech (high-vis, retro-reflectives, taillights) fails to keep riders adequately visible
premises.evidence_span: The current state of the technology for safety is high visibility clothing, or retro-reflectives, or even red taillights. But these are incredibly limited in their functionality and often invisible from outside angles

premises.text: Smart clothing with integrated electronics provides wearable lighting for nighttime safety
premises.evidence_span: pioneering the space of smart clothing by integrating advanced electronics into your gear

premises.text: Mobile app destination tracking drives automatic turn signals, danger-zone strobes, brake lights, and related cues
premises.evidence_span: All you have to do is go into our mobile app, put in your final destination, and let us do the rest

premises.text: Hardware-plus-software lighting can be sold DTC in activewear and via brand licensing into retail and enterprise verticals
premises.evidence_span: We've started with our own line of four pieces focused on sports performance and active wear markets of run, bike, and moto

premises.text: Veteran outdoor-electronics team enables brand partnerships
premises.evidence_span: These partnerships have come because of our veteran team

value.text: Save lives by making wearers visible and communicating intent on the road
value.evidence_span: designed to save lives by visibility at nighttime
